canonical_project: Meghalaya State Data Centre (MSDC), NIC Building Shillong
owner: Department of Information Technology, Government of Meghalaya / Meghalaya Information Technology Society
notes: Official DIT page says the MSDC was inaugurated on 17 August 2011; facility is about 1,800 sq ft on the 2nd floor of the NIC Building, connected to MSWAN and operated 24x7 for government e-governance hosting. DIT news archive shows continuing tenders and maintenance notices for the same State Data Centre through 2025.
